people.name: Robert Lawrence
people.title: Managing Actuary
people.persona: The credentialed signer on most of the firm's opinions and the one who carries the professional exposure that comes with them. He is spare with words in writing and rigorous about separating what the data show from what he has assumed and what he concludes, a discipline he enforces on everyone's drafts. Reviews come back with the qualifiers restored and the adjectives struck. He runs the practice as a working actuary first and a manager second.

people.name: Jennifer Vasquez
people.title: Consulting Actuary
people.persona: Owns client relationships and the day-to-day judgment calls on engagements, translating a board's questions into scoped actuarial work. She writes plainly and hedges on purpose, treating every unqualified sentence as a claim she would later have to defend. She is comfortable telling a client which of their questions the data can answer and which it cannot.

people.name: David Sherman
people.title: Senior Analyst
people.persona: A methodical builder of valuation workbooks who can trace every number in an exhibit back to its source. He reconstructs client data files carefully and documents his reliance on them, flagging anything that looks off before it reaches a report. In email he is terse and precise, more interested in the tie-out than in the narrative around it.

people.name: Jeffrey Ochoa
people.title: Senior Analyst
people.persona: Handles the modeling backbone of engagements and is usually the one who chases a surprising result back to the assumption that produced it. He is patient with messy client data and blunt about its limits, preferring to state the uncertainty rather than paper over it. He writes short factual notes and leaves the interpretation to the signing actuary.

people.name: Megan Dudley
people.title: Actuarial Analyst
people.persona: Works the exhibits and data checks under the senior analysts, still building the instinct for when a number deserves a second look. She is careful and literal in writing, more at ease reporting what she measured than what it means. She asks a lot of clarifying questions, which at this firm is treated as a virtue rather than a nuisance.

people.name: Carol Cooper
people.title: Practice Manager
people.persona: Keeps engagements moving: letters out the door, data requests tracked, deliverables scheduled against the clients' board calendars. Her administrative email is crisp and unhedged, a deliberate contrast to the heavily qualified prose of the actuarial work. She can tell you the status of any open engagement without having to look it up.

people.name: Linda Hanna
people.title: Practice Manager
people.persona: Runs the operational side of client engagements and much of the firm's correspondence with client staff. Her email is brisk and well organized, focused on files, dates, and who owes what to whom. She shares a surname with a colleague in another part of the firm and never remarks on it, the way people at a small shop simply do not.

people.name: Jennifer Johnson
people.title: Actuarial Associate
people.persona: An early-career associate rotating through valuation support and data preparation. She writes carefully and checks before assuming, still learning how much qualification a given sentence needs to carry. She is reliable on the mechanical parts of an engagement and plainly eager to understand the judgment behind them.

people.name: Amanda White
people.title: Actuarial Associate
people.persona: Supports valuations by assembling exhibits and running the data reconciliations that feed them. Her writing is plain and cautious, and she is quick to flag a discrepancy rather than smooth it over. She is absorbing the firm's habit of keeping measurement, assumption, and conclusion in separate sentences.

people.name: Michelle Banks
people.title: Actuarial Associate
people.persona: Handles data intake and preliminary calculations on client engagements. She is precise and unhurried, more likely to note an open question than to guess at its answer. She is comfortable inside a workbook and steadily gaining fluency in the careful language of the reports.

people.name: Karen Harris
people.title: Actuarial Associate
people.persona: Works across engagements on exhibit preparation and assumption tables. She writes short literal notes and defers the interpretation upward, consistent with an associate still earning the judgment calls. She is careful about reliance on client data and about saying only what she can actually support.

people.name: Nicole Hanna
people.title: Actuarial Associate
people.persona: An actuarial associate on the consulting bench, working valuation support and data checks. Her notes are factual and measured, distinguishing what she found from what she assumed. She shares a surname with a colleague elsewhere in the firm and, like the firm itself, treats it as entirely unremarkable.

timeline.summary: Firm moved into its current office.
